answer: Require every agent identity to be backed by a locked, slashable stake plus a history of useful work that cannot be bought in bulk: a newcomer joins only when an established agent vouches for it and locks collateral, like a gardener staking one plant in a shared garden rather than planting a thousand cuttings at once. A bridge of trust forms only after repeated, verifiable deliveries, and each identity carries a quartz-hard record of its past jobs, so creating ten thousand fake agents costs ten thousand bonds and ten thousand histories, while one honest agent pays once.
